<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="LAN party invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GamePreferences" name="Requested games"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateProposal" name="Proposed date"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateResponses" name="Date availability responses"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="LAN party organizer" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Send invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GamePreferences" name="Send requested games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GamePreferences"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateProposal" name="Propose date" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_DateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateResponses" name="Send availability responses" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_PlanParty" name="Plan LAN party">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_GameList</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive list of requested games" messageRef="Message_GamePreferences">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_GameList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Find date and check games" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_AppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CheckGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_AppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Retry_AppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDateProposal" name="Send proposed date to friends" messageRef="Message_DateProposal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveResponses</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" name="Receive date availability responses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveResponses</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Responses_Count</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CountAgreements" name="Count friends who agree on the date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Responses_Count</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Count_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateThreshold" name="Do at least 8 friends agree?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_DateRetry">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Count_Threshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateRetry</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether requested games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CheckGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckGames_Missing</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMissing" name="Are any requested games missing?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_GamesAvailable">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckGames_Missing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMissing_Download</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesAvailable</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMissing_Download</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Download_GamesMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after checking games" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Download_GamesMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesAvailable</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date accepted and games ready" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateAccepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ParallelJoin_BeerEstimate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EstimateBeer" name="Find out how much beer friends require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ParallelJoin_BeerEstimate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerEstimate_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckBeer" name="Check whether there is enough beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerEstimate_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckBeer_Gateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Is there enough beer?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_BeerShortage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckBeer_Gateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerSufficient</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerShortage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerShortage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue with enough beer" gatewayDirection="Converging">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerSufficient</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Party" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_PlanParty" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_GameList" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameList_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDate_SendProposal" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_SendDateProposal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendProposal_ReceiveResponses" sourceRef="Task_SendDateProposal" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Responses_Count" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" targetRef="Task_CountAgreements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Count_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_CountAgreements" targetRef="Gateway_DateThreshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAccepted" name="At least 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateThreshold" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">At least 8 friends agree on the date</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateRetry" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateThreshold" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGames_Missing" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing_Download" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Some requested games are missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="No games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMerge_ParallelJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ParallelJoin_BeerEstimate" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_EstimateBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEstimate_Check" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Task_CheckBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckBeer_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerSufficient" name="Enough beer is available" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Available beer is sufficient</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerShortage" name="Beer is insufficient" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_Party"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
